description: Find the cheapest Azure VM sizes that meet vCPU, memory and workload requirements, with monthly USD list prices. Burstable (B-series) and confidential sizes are only included when that workload is requested.

min_gpus.description: Minimum number of whole GPUs (partitioned GPUs such as 1/6 A10 do not count).

need_temp_disk.description: Only sizes with a local temporary disk.

os.description: Operating system for pay-as-you-go prices. Default linux.

region.description: Azure region, e.g. westeurope or "West Europe". Omit to use each size's cheapest region.

sort.description: price = cheapest first (default); fit = least spare vCPU/memory first.

workload.description: Workload family. ai = NVIDIA GPUs only (CUDA, PyTorch, vLLM); gpu = any GPU incl. AMD. Omit for any (excludes burstable and confidential).

name: find_vm_sizes

dataSource.description: pricesAsOf (ISO date), currency, source, dataset, stale (true if the weekly refresh is late).

gpu.description: Present for GPU sizes: model, vendor, count, share (e.g. 1/6), cudaAiStack, label.

title: Find Azure VM sizes
